jobs.title: Digital Web Product Manager
jobs.description:
We’re building a world of health around every individual — shaping a more connected, convenient and compassionate health experience. At CVS Health®, you’ll be surrounded by passionate colleagues who care deeply, innovate with purpose, hold ourselves accountable and prioritize safety and quality in everything we do. Join us and be part of something bigger – helping to simplify health care one person, one family and one community at a time.

Position Summary
As a Digital Product Manager, you will be delivering improvements on our Aetna Medicare public websites. You’ll be part of a team responsible for building smart, integrated, and automated ecosystems within a content management system that increase engagement and lead quality, and delight audiences. The Digital Product Manager will put the customer first, monitor the competitive landscape, understand our technical capabilities, champion user experiences, and ensure successful market launch of new products and features.

This role sits within the Marketing Technology and Digital Experiences group (Aetna MarTech) and you will report to the Lead Director, MarTech Product Management.

Your job responsibilities will be to:
- Product Strategy & Journey mapping: Define initiative vision, target journeys and outcomes for Aetna Medicare public website experiences; align priorities to business goals and needs
- Roadmap & prioritization: Own the product roadmap and backlog, make transparent tradeoffs to maximize consumer impact, business value and delivery feasibility
- Cross-Portfolio Collaboration: Partner with business and marketing partners to understand needs, align on scope and success measures, and influence decisions based on MarTech priorities and platform standards
- Cross functional leadership: Lead day-to-day collaboration across UX, engineering, compliance/legal and analytics through discovery, delivery, and continuous improvement.
- Customer-Centered Innovation: Use research, data and experimentation to identify pain points and opportunities; translate insights into testable hypotheses and prioritized feature work
- Agile Execution: Break strategy into Epics and features; partner with delivery teams to write clear requirements (user stories/acceptance criteria), support refinement and drive execution through release.
- Risk, Dependency & Stakeholder Management: Identify dependencies early, surface risks & constraints, and proactively manage tradeoffs to maintain timeline, quality and compliance
- Performance Optimization: Define KPIs and measurement plans; monitor performance, run A/B tests and usability studies, deliver iterative enhancements to improve engagement and conversion
- Market & Competitor Awareness: Track digital health and web experience trends; synthesize implications and recommend opportunities for the roadmap that support the goals.
- Technical releases: Support releases (e.g. Adobe Experience Manager) to ensure that site remains compliant with minimal production issues

Who you are:
- A Leader - You know what it takes to stay focused and are ready to take on cross-functional initiatives, spanning multiple teams in a matrixed environment. And you’re comfortable problem solving and making decisions on your own
- Analytical - You get the data and how it can tell a story and help you make decisions.
- Collaborative – You enjoy working cross functionally and you know how to communicate (both verbally and in writing) with a wide variety of audiences
- Flexible - You're at home leading Agile teams, know how to guide iterative optimization using A/B testing and personalization strategies
- Tech-Forward – You are comfortable with the Adobe stack (AEM (Adobe Experience Manager), Target, Analytics). You’ve had exposure to different technology platforms and can talk integrations when needed. You are eager to use technology to solve problems.
- Dynamic - You have a high tolerance for change and can prioritize multiple competing demands. You know how to keep lots of balls in the air and not let anything slip through the cracks
- Customer centric –  You are driven by improving the user experience for the consumer to ensure that they can be successful while balancing with the company’s needs.
- Passion & purpose - You think building stuff is exciting, you believe helping people achieve positive health outcomes is amazing, and you bring that passion to work every day

Required Qualifications
- 5+ years’ experience in digital product role delivering consumer-facing products, with evidence of success and increasing levels of responsibility
- 1+ years’ Agile product management experience leading cross-functional teams
- Highly skilled at professional communication with good business acumen

Preferred Qualifications
- Experience in healthcare or another highly regulated industry
- Experience with the Adobe stack (AEM, Target, Customer Journey Analytics)
- Experience in a highly matrixed or enterprise organization

Education
- Bachelor’s degree or equivalent experience

The typical pay range for this role is:

$130,295.00 - $284,280.00

jobs.description:

Position Summary
As a Senior Product Manager, you will lead product strategy and roadmap development for the organization's Epic electronic health record (EHR) platform and integrated clinical informatics tools. You will own the product strategy and requirements for our Revenue Cycle Management (RCM) domain, which is focused on CDI, coding, billing, collections, integrity and analytics. These are critical for ensuring the end to end workflow from accurate clinical documentation to appropriate coding and A/R completeness. You’ll apply deep Epic platform expertise, user-centric design, and agile methodologies to drive adoption, quality, and safety across enterprise informatics initiatives to improve healthcare delivery for our patients.

What You'll Do
- Responsible for defining the product vision and strategic direction for your Epic Domain, ensuring continuous alignment with senior business and engineering leaders. You'll translate high-level business goals into a clear, actionable product strategy that are tied to OKRs.
- Partner with business stakeholders to define the product roadmap, overseeing day-to-day backlog management and prioritization to ensure alignment with your strategic vision. You will assess value and develop business cases to inform the nature and scope of new initiatives. This includes evaluating buy vs. build opportunities and identifying opportunities to scale products to multiple business units
- Coordinate with talented technical partners from engineering, data science, and user design in a fast-paced, agile environment to build and enhance products. Your role is to bridge the gap between business needs and technical solutions, fostering a collaborative and productive atmosphere.
- Work alongside our design team to design high-quality, intuitive products for our end-users. This involves user research, gathering and documenting detailed product requirements and ensuring the final product meets user needs and expectations.
- Define and manage the launch of new products, including working with our operations teams to create training materials and documentation for end-users. You will also continuously identify and act on opportunities for product improvement through quantitative analysis and user feedback.
- Delivers executive-level reporting on product status, risks, and decisions needed, and builds strong relationships with key stakeholders across the enterprise.
- Develops testing procedures and governance for onsite, monthly, and quarterly Epic assessments, with detailed documentation review.
- Partners with training and change management teams to support readiness, adoption, and feedback loops for Epic-based product releases.
- Supports approval of product iterations, schedules, releases, and roadmaps to maintain delivery speed and quality across Epic initiatives.
- Support the domain leaders in recruiting, hiring, and developing product and informatics talent in a collaborative, fast-paced, global environment to instill industry-proven best practices.

Required Qualifications
- 5+ years experience in Revenue Cycle Management, including charge capture, medical coding, back-end billing (e.g. claims submission, clearing house rules, EDI formats) and collections (e.g. denial management, appeals, patient billing, A/R)
- 7–10 years of relevant work experience in product management and/or healthcare informatics
- Proven Leader: You're comfortable driving strategic decisions, taking ownership, and coordinating resources to ensure successful project outcomes
- Highly Collaborative: You excel at working with senior-level stakeholders and can translate complex technical topics for a variety of audiences
- Data-Driven Mindset: You believe in using data to measure product impact and work with analytics teams to evaluate success
- Skilled in change management and driving user adoption of clinical technology.

Preferred Qualifications
- Epic certification(s) in one or more modules relevant to the role (e.g., EpicCare Ambulatory, Healthy Planet, Beacon, Willow, Prelude, Cadence, Resolute Professional Billing, HIM, MyChart, Beaker, Welcome Kiosk, Rover, Haiku, EpicCare Link, Caboodle, SlicerDicer, Bridges, Reporting Workbench, Orders).
- Experience in Value Based Care, Medicare/Medicare Advantage and Fee-For-Service with understanding of financial operations with capitation, shared savings and bundled payments.
- Comfort operating in a regulated environment with data privacy and compliance considerations.
- Experience building and launching AI products
- 3+ years as a Product Manager

Owns the product lifecycle for Epic-integrated solutions from ideation through delivery, partnering with clinical, technical, and operational stakeholders to translate business and clinical needs into product requirements. Applies deep Epic platform expertise, user-centric design, and agile methodologies to drive adoption, quality, and safety across enterprise informatics initiatives to improve healthcare delivery for our patients.
A Brief Overview
Defines product vision and strategy for Epic domain through discovery, requirements definition, configuration, and enhancement of Epic and related informatics products and tools. Conducts user research with clinical and business stakeholders, collaborates with cross-functional and technical teams, designs workflows and user experiences, and oversees the product development lifecycle. Applies deep Epic expertise, agile methodologies, and informatics best practices to ensure Epic-based solutions meet clinical, operational, and end-user needs while driving business outcomes.
What You Will Do
- Acts as the product owner for Epic and informatics solutions, understanding the clinical, operational, and competitive landscape to advance the organization's technical solutions to support healthcare delivery.
- Owns the full product lifecycle for Epic-based tools and workflows, from gathering ideas through prototyping, build, testing, and go-live. This includes vendor evaluations for buy vs. build options.
- Creates features, stories, and workflow designs for current and future Epic products based on clinical insights, stakeholder research, and Customer Experience (CX) needs.
- Defines and drives execution pathways by translating strategic informatics goals into actionable product requirements and project plans, including milestones, deliverables, and dependencies across workstreams.
- Partners with business, clinical, and operational teams to build a product vision, identify business and clinical value, and translate use cases and capabilities into clear, actionable product strategy that is tied to organizational objectives and OKRs.
- Coordinates with technical partners across engineering, data science, integration, and architecture teams in a fast-paced, agile development process to enhance the organization's Epic ecosystem.
- Develops and maintains risk and issue logs, identifying, assessing, and mitigating risks across technical and operational domains, with clear escalation and resolution pathways.
- Ensures workstream integration and alignment across clinical, technical, and operational groups, leading effective cross-functional meetings with clear agendas, follow-ups, and accountability.
- Delivers executive-level reporting on product status, risks, and decisions needed, and builds strong relationships with key stakeholders across the enterprise.
- Develops testing procedures and governance for onsite, monthly, and quarterly Epic assessments, with detailed documentation review.
- Partners with training and change management teams to support readiness, adoption, and feedback loops for Epic-based product releases.
- Supports approval of product iterations, schedules, releases, and roadmaps to maintain delivery speed and quality across Epic initiatives.
- Support the domain leaders in recruiting, hiring, and developing product and informatics talent in a collaborative, fast-paced, global environment to instill industry-proven best practices.

For This Role You Will Need - Minimum Requirements
- 7–10 years of relevant work experience, including experience in product management and healthcare informatics or health IT product/project management.
- Deep Epic expertise, including hands-on experience managing, configuring, or overseeing Epic software, modules, and tools within a healthcare enterprise.
- Ability to deliver complex healthcare technology projects on time and within scope
- Proven Leader: Comfortable driving strategic decisions, taking ownership, and coordinating resources to ensure successful project outcomes
- Highly Collaborative: Excel at working with senior-level stakeholders and can translate complex technical topics for a variety of audiences in a matrixed environment
- Data-Driven Mindset: Uses data to measure product impact and work with analytics teams to evaluate success.
- Adept at problem solving and decision making.
- Adept at collaboration and teamwork.
- Adept at growth mindset (agility and developing yourself and others).
- Adept at execution and delivery (planning, delivering, and supporting).
- Adept at business intelligence and translating data into actionable insight.
- Skilled in change management and driving user adoption of clinical technology.

Preferred Qualifications

jobs.location: Work at Home, Arizona, United States
jobs.description:
We’re building a world of health around every individual — shaping a more connected, convenient and compassionate health experience. At CVS Health®, you’ll be surrounded by passionate colleagues who care deeply, innovate with purpose, hold ourselves accountable and prioritize safety and quality in everything we do. Join us and be part of something bigger – helping to simplify health care one person, one family and one community at a time.

Job Purpose and Summary
- Leads software product management for the Security Automation portfolio within Enterprise Information Security at CVS Health and serves as the direct peer and partner to the Lead Director, Security Automation.  Together the two leaders run the portfolio: an engineering and product pairing modeled directly on how commercial software organizations operate.
- Applies commercial-grade product management discipline to internally built security products. The portfolio automates and improves security operations, analysis, and management functions for the Security organization and for CVS Health colleagues, and its users are demanding professionals with day jobs — security operations analysts, GRC and audit teams, identity and infrastructure engineers, application teams, and in some cases colleagues across the enterprise. This leader owns continuous discovery with those users, translates workflow pain into a prioritized roadmap, defines the outcomes each product is accountable for, and holds the portfolio to those outcomes rather than to a delivery calendar.
- Owns adoption as a first-class responsibility rather than a post-launch afterthought. Internal products fail in a specific and well-documented way: they are built on unverified assumptions, launched without enablement, mandated rather than adopted, and quietly abandoned. This role exists to prevent that. Accountable for internal go-to-market, enablement and documentation, onboarding of successive user groups, instrumented adoption and usage measurement, structured feedback channels, iteration against what the evidence shows, and the discipline to sunset or replace solutions that are not earning their place in the portfolio.
- Leads and develops a team of product managers, with coaching and craft development as the primary work rather than personally owning products. Sets the standard for discovery, problem framing, requirements quality, and outcome measurement; hires and levels PMs; and creates the conditions for empowered product and engineering pairs to solve problems rather than execute specifications. Operates as a peer-level partner to engineering leadership, a credible voice to security function owners who did not ask to be automated, and a clear communicator to executive sponsors who need to understand what the investment is buying.

*This role can work remotely from anywhere in the continental USA.

Primary Responsibilities
- Owns product strategy, vision, and the multi-year roadmap for the Security Automation portfolio in partnership with the Lead Director, Security Automation; frames the problems worth solving, sequences investment against enterprise security priorities, and maintains a defensible, communicable position on why the portfolio is working on what it is working on and what it has deliberately chosen not to do
- Leads, builds, and develops the product management team, treating the coaching and development of product managers as the core of the job rather than personally managing products; hires and levels PMs, sets the standard for product craft, runs a structured development approach, and leads by context rather than by control
- Owns product discovery for the portfolio including direct, continuous contact with the security practitioners and CVS Health colleagues whose work the portfolio is meant to change; workflow and pain-point analysis, opportunity sizing, assumption testing before build, and validation that a proposed automation solves a problem the users actually have
- Owns adoption and the full product lifecycle for everything the portfolio ships including internal launch and go-to-market, enablement, documentation and training, onboarding of new user groups, support and feedback channels, iteration based on real usage, and the decision to sunset or replace solutions that are not earning their keep
- Defines and instruments the outcome measures for each product and for the portfolio as a whole including adoption and active-usage measures, manual-effort and cycle-time reduction, support deflection, and risk-reduction proxies; establishes baselines before delivery, reports honestly against them afterward, and treats shipped features as inputs rather than results
- Owns requirements definition and the delivery partnership with engineering including problem statements, user stories and acceptance criteria, backlog health, release planning, scope and tradeoff decisions during delivery, and clear division of decision rights between product and engineering
- Partners on build-versus-buy and commercial evaluation, bringing market scanning, competitive and vendor landscape analysis, requirements definition for proofs-of-concept, and total-cost-of-ownership and licensing analysis to decisions about whether a capability should be built, bought, or assembled on an existing enterprise platform
- Serves as the primary product-facing voice to stakeholders and senior leadership including security function owners, Technology and Digital partners, and executive sponsors; communicates roadmap, tradeoffs, progress, and outcomes in language appropriate to each audience and secures the sponsorship the portfolio depends on
- Owns the business case and financial framing for portfolio investments including benefit quantification, ROI and payback analysis, license and vendor cost modeling, and the value narrative used to defend and grow investment in the function
- Establishes and matures the product management practice for the function including intake and prioritization mechanisms, discovery and requirements standards, roadmap and release communication cadence, product documentation standards, and the tooling that supports them

Required Qualifications:
- 12+ years of experience in technology roles, including 8+ years in software product management

- 4+ years leading product managers, including hiring, coaching, performance management, and career development — with demonstrated understanding that leading PMs is a different job from managing products personally

- Product management experience gained in a commercial software or SaaS organization is strongly preferred; candidates from internal-platform or enterprise-IT-only backgrounds should be able to demonstrate equivalent product rigor

- Demonstrated ownership of product strategy and multi-year roadmaps for a software product or portfolio, including the ability to articulate what was deliberately not built and why

- Strong product discovery practice: direct user research and workflow analysis, opportunity sizing, assumption and risk testing before committing to build, and evidence-based decision making rather than requirements collection

- Demonstrated ability to define, instrument, and report on outcome measures — adoption, active usage, effort and cycle-time reduction, support deflection, retention of usage over time — including establishing baselines before delivery

- Track record of driving adoption of software products, with specific, quantified examples including at least one case where adoption stalled and what the candidate changed in response

- Demonstrated prioritization judgment under real constraint, including examples of telling significant stakeholders no and managing the relationship afterward

- Experience owning requirements definition and the delivery partnership with engineering: problem statements, user stories and acceptance criteria, backlog health, release planning, and in-flight scope and tradeoff decisions

- Technical fluency sufficient to earn the trust of engineers and to participate credibly in architecture, integration, and feasibility discussions — including comfort with APIs, data models, and software delivery practice. Coding ability is not required

- Experience with build-versus-buy analysis and commercial software evaluation, including vendor and market assessment and total-cost-of-ownership reasoning

- Demonstrated ability to influence peers, senior stakeholders, and executives without direct authority, and to build genuine co-ownership with partner teams rather than transactional requirements relationships

- Financial acumen: business case construction, benefit quantification, ROI and payback analysis, and budget and license cost management

- Strong written communication — product briefs, strategy narratives, and roadmap communication that hold up without a presenter — and strong verbal communication across engineer-to-executive audiences

- Experience operating in agile delivery models and with modern product and delivery tooling (e.g., Jira, product analytics, roadmap and discovery tools)

Preferred Qualifications:
- Experience as a product manager or product leader for developer-facing, platform, or internal-facing software products, where users must be won rather than acquired

- Experience in a security, risk, compliance, or IT operations product domain, or demonstrated ability to learn a technical operational domain quickly and credibly

- Experience with workflow automation, integration, or data platform products, including products whose value is measured in effort avoided rather than revenue generated

- Experience with AI-enabled or agentic product management: defining human-in-the-loop experiences, evaluating model accuracy and failure modes, and setting user expectations for probabilistic systems

- Experience with product-led adoption motions — self-service onboarding, in-product guidance, documentation as a product surface, and community or champion programs

- Advanced degree or MBA; recognized product management or agile credentials

Education

- Master's Degree or MBA preferred
